intro: The Hallowed Tablet is an inscribed message delivered to young Darkspear troll priests training in the Valley of Trials. Sent by the spiritual elder Ken'jai, it bids novices to seek him out and begin learning how to commune with the spirits.

p: When a promising troll priest takes their first steps in the harsh crimson canyons of the Valley of Trials, Gornek hands them the Hallowed Tablet. Rather than a formal bureaucratic writ, it serves as a personal invitation from Ken'jai, the resident priest trainer residing outside the Den. Ken'jai interprets the signs and whisperings of the spirits, sensing when young Darkspear with spiritual potential arrive in Durotar. The tablet instructs the initiate to read its words and present themselves for guidance on properly channeling spiritual authority.
